issue_request: FHIR-25252 asked to clarify the $process-message response format text because the operation said the response content type was always a message Bundle while examples and asynchronous wording showed an empty response; it also asked to clarify that synchronous messages do not always require a response payload. Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution for R5.

The old return documentation wording was later aligned by existing combined-branch process-message reconciliation, especially FHIR-27544.
additional_context: The cited Zulip thread records the underlying consensus that valid outcomes include 200 with no body, a message Bundle when a response payload is returned, or HTTP error/OperationOutcome. FHIR-I minutes on 2020-04-13 record the Persuasive vote. MessageHeader is active in source/fhir.ini, and later already-published combined commits FHIR-25465, FHIR-27544, and FHIR-34117 touched adjacent response wording without requiring a new FHIR-25252 source edit.
